data.title: Premium government data, free.
data.sub: Where AcreOS runs deepest for Land Investors: flood, soil, elevation, and wetlands checks on every parcel from public government data — before you ever pay for a data subscription. Paid providers come later, when your deal volume earns them.

sources.what: National Flood Hazard Layer — flood zone and risk.
SSURGO soil survey — type, capability class, drainage.
3DEP elevation — point elevation and slope context.
National Wetlands Inventory — mapped wetland presence.
ACS tract context — population and median income.

data.promise: Every parcel gets these checks at no cost. Paid data (parcel ownership, skip-trace) stays behind your own key, so you only pay for it when a deal justifies it.

landCreditScore.title: A credit score for the parcel — not the person.
landCreditScore.sub: Every parcel AcreOS touches gets a Land Credit Score: a single 300–850 read, graded A+ through F, of how a piece of land stacks up as an investment. It scores the dirt, not the buyer. It is not a consumer credit report and pulls no personal credit.
landCreditScore.scaleNote: 300–850 scale · A+ through F · recomputed as the underlying data changes.
landCreditScore.dimensionsSub: The score is a weighted blend of six dimensions, drawn from the same government and market data behind every parcel check.
landCreditScore.methodologyNote: Published methodology, version v1 — the weights below are the methodology. Any change to the weights, scale, or grade thresholds revs the version, and every free parcel report is stamped with the version that produced it.

dimensions.name: Location
dimensions.what: Market strength, population growth, economic health, accessibility.

dimensions.name: Financial
dimensions.what: Cash flow, appreciation, liquidity, tax burden, carrying cost.

dimensions.name: Physical
dimensions.what: Topography, soil quality, water access, utilities, road access.

dimensions.name: Legal
dimensions.what: Zoning, restrictions, mineral rights, water rights, clear title.

dimensions.name: Environmental
dimensions.what: Flood risk, wildfire, contamination, wetlands, protected species.

dimensions.name: Market
dimensions.what: Demand, supply, price history, days on market, comparable sales.

landCreditScore.sampleLabel: Illustrative — example output, not a real parcel
landCreditScore.honestTitle: What it is — and what it isn't
honest: It scores parcels, not people. No personal or consumer credit is involved.
It is not a FICO score, a consumer credit report, or a regulated credit product.
It is a decision aid, not a guarantee — the operator still makes the call.
It updates as the underlying flood, soil, market, and ownership data changes.
